name: A19 one-formula candidate T44 (MOGF0IESR, w = 0.1): T43 with the KiDS lens stacks' halo concentrations scaled by Neto et al. (2007)'s all-to-relaxed ratio, because lensing stacks average over all haloes while Dutton and Maccio (2014) describe relaxed haloes
frozen_at: 2026-11-07 04:56 PST, session SA73 overnight, after T44 (held out, PROTOCOL_T44); T43 (711264dd...) and T37 (9d0bc8d4..., the formula that took the HeCS blind test) stay frozen
halo_formula: M_ref = Mp/fb + 10^A (M*/1e10 Msun)^B (Re/3 kpc)^C + q M_E(M*, z | S), q = 1 for samples selected by their halos (S not 1), else q = (M*/Mp)^50 / (1 + (M_t/M*)^4); M_halo = (M_ref^8 + (1e8 Msun)^8)^(1/8); M_E = posterior mean of M200c on a grid in log10 M200c from 9.0 to 16.5 (step 0.005) with weight dn/dlnM (Tinker et al. 2008, colossus, H0 67.1, Om 0.3175, Ob 0.049, sigma8 0.8344, ns 0.9624) x exp(-0.5 [(log10 M* - log10 M*_Moster(M200c, z))/0.180]^2) x S(M200c) (Moster, Naab and White 2013 with redshift evolution; 0.180 = sqrt(0.15^2 + 0.10^2) dex); below M* = 10^9.5 Msun M_E is the mean inversion; NFW with dark mass (1-fb) M_halo inside r200 at the halo redshift, Dutton and Maccio (2014) concentration, satellites x (1 - 0.54 log10(D/r200,host)) (Moline et al. 2017); no contraction; fb = 0.049/0.3175, h = 0.671; lensing M_p as a point mass; KiDS lens stacks only: c x (4.67/5.26) (M200 h / 1e14 Msun)^(-0.01) (Neto et al. 2007, Millennium: median c of all haloes over relaxed haloes; about 0.93 at 1e12 Msun)

selection_S.CLASH clusters: M200c > 5e14 Msun (Postman et al. 2012: X-ray selected, kT > 5 keV)
selection_S.MaNGA BCGs: M200c > 1e14 Msun (the MaNGA BCG program's aim)
selection_S.every other sample (disks, dwarfs, early: none (chosen by their light, not their halos)

baryons: as T26: stellar g_bar of spheroids with a measured velocity dispersion x alpha_IMF = 10^(0.38 log10(sigma_e/200 km/s) - 0.06 + 0.215) (Posacki et al. 2015; Chabrier scale via Madau and Dickinson 2014), for the 50 MaNGA BCGs and the 16 SPARC early types
coefficient_count: 4 (A, B, C set on disks alone; log10 M_t from the joint fit); the selection thresholds are taken from the surveys, not fitted
dwarf_upper_limits_exceeded: 3 of 10 (unchanged: the switch is zero for dwarfs)
caveats: the lensing change was chosen after an all-data look (explore_cscan.py) showed the KiDS stacks prefer lower concentrations; its size is fixed by Neto et al. (2007), not fitted

which samples count as relaxed is a modeling choice: rotation-curve samples (regular kinematics), CLASH (relaxed X-ray morphology) and individually modeled galaxies keep the relaxed relation; only the stacks average over all haloes
adaptive: T43's change was motivated by the HeCS blind test of T37 (T40), so HeCS cannot test T43; a new blind sample is needed

M_t is weakly set by the benchmark once halo-selected samples no longer depend on it: it reaches its upper bound in 3 of 60 held-out fits (20 of 60 on the stricter mask); with all data it is 10^11.19, and the SDSS red centrals (Mandelbaum et al. 2016, not fitted) agree (0.14 dex rms)
MaNGA depends on the program's stated threshold: at 10^13.8 suns it scores 0.123 to 0.125 (T34)
CLASH's selection is stated in temperature (kT > 5 keV); 5e14 suns M200c is its mass equivalent; the gain holds from 3e14 to 7e14 (T34)
lensing remains the weakest score (69.5 against 49.1 for an 18-coefficient mixture); the KiDS early/late split stays about a third of the measured one
the early types' inner points are ATLAS3D JAM values, which Posacki et al. used
status: retrospective and adaptive; frozen here for a blind test on new systems
